title: Question 1
question: Who is the poet of “The Road Not Taken”?
answer: Robert Frost.

title: Question 2
question: What do the two roads symbolize in “The Road Not Taken”?
answer: They symbolize choices and decisions in life.

title: Question 3
question: Why did the poet feel sorry in “The Road Not Taken”?
answer: He could not travel both roads and had to choose one.

title: Question 4
question: Who was Kezia in “The Little Girl”?
answer: Kezia was a little girl who was afraid of her strict father.

title: Question 5
question: Why was Kezia afraid of her father?
answer: He appeared strict and spoke to her in a commanding manner.

title: Question 6
question: How did Kezia’s opinion of her father change?
answer: She understood his love and care when he comforted her during the night.

title: Question 7
question: Who is the poet of “Rain on the Roof”?
answer: Coates Kinney.

title: Question 8
question: What memories does the sound of rain bring to the poet?
answer: It brings memories of his mother and childhood.

title: Question 9
question: What is the central idea of “The Fun They Had”?
answer: It contrasts future mechanical education with traditional schools.

title: Question 10
question: Why did Margie hate school?
answer: She disliked her mechanical teacher and the tests it gave her.

title: Question 11
question: Who was Evelyn Glennie?
answer: A Scottish percussionist who became a successful musician despite profound hearing loss.

title: Question 12
question: How did Evelyn learn to feel music?
answer: She sensed musical vibrations through different parts of her body.

title: Question 13
question: Who was Abdul Kalam’s close childhood friend mentioned in “My Childhood”?
answer: Ramanadha Sastry.

title: Question 14
question: What values did Kalam learn from his parents?
answer: Honesty, self-discipline, kindness and faith.

title: Question 15
question: Why did the child in “The Lost Child” refuse the things he wanted earlier?
answer: After losing his parents, he wanted only to be reunited with them.

title: Question 16
question: What is the main message of “The Happy Prince”?
answer: True happiness lies in compassion, generosity and helping others.

title: Question 17
question: Why did the swallow stay with the Happy Prince?
answer: It was moved by the Prince’s kindness and chose to help him.

title: Question 18
question: What did the guru teach his disciple in “In the Kingdom of Fools”?
answer: He taught him that foolish rulers and irrational rules can be dangerous.

title: Question 19
question: What is the main theme of “The Last Leaf”?
answer: Hope, sacrifice and the healing power of love.

title: Question 20
question: Why is the last leaf important in the story?
answer: It gives Johnsy hope and the will to live; Behrman painted it as his masterpiece.
